paper.title: ChaCha, a variant of Salsa20
paper.venue: SASC 2008 (Workshop Record of The State of the Art of Stream Ciphers)

program.how: written for ounce-core from the paper's description of the state layout, quarter-round and round structure; no third-party code copied
program.target: static freestanding aarch64 Linux ELF, run with `ounce-core run-elf`

claims_checked: ChaCha8, ChaCha12 and ChaCha20 with 128-bit and 256-bit keys and a 64-bit IV (the original 64-bit counter layout) produce the published keystream: 96 blocks of 64 bytes (blocks 0 and 1 of 48 vectors) all match

expected_values_source.what: the 48 keystream vectors (8 test cases x 2 key sizes x 3 round counts, two blocks each) of the IETF Internet-Draft 'Test Vectors for the Stream Cipher ChaCha' (J. Strombergson, Secworks Sweden AB, October 2013); parsed mechanically from the fetched draft text
expected_values_source.note: the draft says the vectors were generated by a simple generator based on Bernstein's chacha.c reference and verified against it; the paper itself prints no test vectors. The vectors are data, copied as numbers; no code from the draft or the reference was copied

negative_control: built with -DCH_ROT_B=11 (rotation 11 instead of 12 in the quarter-round), 0 of 96 blocks match and the program exits 1; check.sh reports NOT REPRODUCED
not_checked: the paper's security argument, or any cryptanalysis
the IETF variant (32-bit counter, 96-bit nonce) and XChaCha; RFC 8439's ChaCha20 is a separate check (chacha20-poly1305)
encryption of non-zero plaintext and counters beyond 1 (the vectors are the raw keystream of blocks 0 and 1)
speed figures (emulator run time says nothing about the authors' hardware)
Tier-4 and native ARM64 execution (the native comparison is x86-64)
what_a_pass_means: this program, run on ounce-core, produces exactly the published keystream blocks for the 48 vectors. The vectors come from a third-party generator run on the author's reference code, so this is agreement with that reference, not an independent derivation.
